solution.title: M365 & Azure Incident Response & Escalation Runbook

products.name: M365 & Azure Incident Response & Escalation Runbook — Commercial
products.short_description: Lead high-priority and escalated incidents across Microsoft 365 and Azure with a complete runbook — severity matrix, triage, per-workload diagnostic playbooks (Exchange, Entra, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive, Intune, Azure), Service Health checks, client comms templates, Microsoft escalation, root-cause analysis, and the convert-to-permanent-fix loop. Self-guided, tested.
products.description:
Lead any M365 or Azure incident — and stop it from happening again

When a high-priority incident hits a managed M365/Azure estate, the difference between a controlled response and chaos is a runbook. This solution provides one: a severity & impact matrix, defined incident roles, fast triage (impact × risk × effort), diagnostic playbooks per workload (Exchange Online mail flow, Entra ID sign-in/auth, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive, Intune, Azure resource health), Microsoft Service Health checks, client communication templates + cadence, structured escalation to Microsoft, and a disciplined root-cause analysis that converts recurring issues into permanent fixes via configuration, automation, or design.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Detect → Triage → Communicate → Diagnose → Resolve → RCA → Permanent Fix model.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (responder M365/Azure roles, log access — sign-in/audit, message trace, Azure Monitor; a Microsoft support plan, a PSA/ticketing system, on-call + comms channels) with how to verify and how to implement it if missing, plus the category Global Requirements.
  • Implementation Guide — stand up the severity matrix, incident-record + comms + RCA templates, the per-workload diagnostic playbooks (with full console nav paths), the Microsoft escalation sheet, and the problem-management/permanent-fix process.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Service-Health + risk snapshot, responder-readiness validation, incident timeline/MTTA-MTTR report, safe common-fix remediation, and a responder-roles setup helper.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates (validated via a tabletop incident), plus Best Practices.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every M365/Azure incident led calmly to resolution with the client kept informed, root cause found, and the issue converted into a permanent fix so it does not recur — run by your own team.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • INCIDENT-Discovery.ps1 — Read-only live incident snapshot across Microsoft 365 + Azure
    • INCIDENT-Remediation.ps1 — Safe, scoped common-fix helper for a NAMED object (-WhatIf by default)
    • INCIDENT-Report.ps1 — Incident timeline / metrics report (MTTA / MTTR) to CSV
    • INCIDENT-Set-ResponderRoles.ps1 — Create the responder Entra group + assign reader roles (-WhatIf)
    • INCIDENT-Validation.ps1 — Responder readiness check (PASS/FAIL)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.

Government / GCC High tenant? A dedicated Government (GCC High) edition of this solution is available — authored for the US sovereign cloud (correct *.us portals, US Gov Graph endpoints, and Commercial-vs-GCC-High feature parity gaps called out).
